messages:
erin: Heads-up — seeing a steady KV cache memory ramp in long-context PagedAttention runs across H100 and MI250. Not a one-off spike, grows over token stream (10k+ tokens) until we hit OOM-ish behavior. Posting minimal traces below.

jamal: ugh. repro script? sample model, batch sizes?

erin: repro is `./scripts/repro_pagedattn.sh --model gptx-8b --seq 32k --batch 1 --arch mix-h100-mi250`. Observed on both single GPU and multi-GPU mixed. Quick grep from trace: ```
[KV] epoch=0 nv_pages_alloc=1200mb -> 3600mb (tokens=10500)
[PT] free_holes=34 hole_scar=0.72 compactness=0.41
[Evict] scanned=1024 retired=8 coalesce_attempts=0
```

sahil: that compactness number is suspiciously low. Could be fragmentation preventing coalescing and preventing reuse. Any page-retire logs or stale owner warnings?

erin: we see repeated "page_retire_deferred" entries around the wavefront of allocations. Example: `page_retire_deferred: owner_mismatch=1 reason=refcount_nonzero`. Rough stack: kernel A -> pager thread -> retire attempt -> deferred.

mira: can you run with KV_DEBUG=1 and PAGE_COALESCE=1 and post the shorttrace? also try forcing `ALLOW_PAGE_REUSE=0` to see if reuse logic is causing the ramp.

erin: ran KV_DEBUG=1, shorttrace excerpt: ```
[KV DEBUG] alloc_page id=0x1f3 age=0 refs=2 last_used_tok=10234 flags=PAGE_PINNED
[KV DEBUG] scan_window sz=512 candidates=27 fragmented_runs=13
[KV DEBUG] coalesce_skipped id=0x1f3 reason=noncontig_stride
```

jamal: noncontig_stride + pinned pages explains why coalesce attempts = 0 earlier. Might be kernel tiling pattern for PagedAttention on those archs producing noncontig page layout. Did the kernel selector pick different tiling on H100 vs MI250?

mira: yes — we recently landed a kernel selection change that prefers wavefront-tiling for MI-series (patch #3521). H100 still uses warp-tiling. Mixed workloads may interleave allocations with different strides -> fragmentation.

sahil: idea: add a compact-on-threshold policy that triggers a background coalesce when hole_scar > 0.6 OR when alloc rate > X. Cheap heuristic: coalesce only when freed_runs > 64 to avoid perf hit.

jamal: also add telemetry counters: page_coalesce_attempts, coalesce_success_rate, retire_deferred_count, fragmented_runs_histogram. We need to quantify before changing eviction. I'll add the counters and a small dashboard.

erin: note: forcing ALLOW_PAGE_REUSE=0 reduced ramp in a quick smoke (peak ~1.3GB lower) but perf dropped ~8% on throughput — expected. So reuse code seems to be letting bad layouts persist.

mira: quick mitigation: try making kernel selector prefer uniform-tiling for PagedAttention when multi-arch mixing detected in pool. Env toggle: `KERNEL_SELECTOR=prefer_uniform_for_pagedattn` — can we canary this?

jamal: planning canary. I'll push a non-prod rollout for `prefer_uniform_for_pagedattn` on a small subset of hosts tonight and attach the new counters.

perf-bot: perf-trace uploaded: https://perf.internal/redwood/trace/6480001234-wavefront-ramp (auto-instrumentation attached) :eyes:

erin: next steps: jamal to add counters & dashboard, mira to prepare kernel-selector toggle flag, sahil to prototype compact-on-threshold heuristic, erin to collect traces from canary and prod repros. I'll open an issue with the logs + repro.

sahil: small note — when you prototype compaction, test with synthetic interleaved-tiling allocs. I can drop a microbench to fuzz stride patterns.

jamal: agreed. I'll also add an alert if retire_deferred_count spikes 3x baseline.

erin: thanks all. filing bug now and tagging this thread in the issue. :thumbsup:
